# Productify

> Productify is the best free daily habit tracker app for iPhone. Build lasting routines with AI insights, streak tracking, Habit Duo accountability, and 50+ templates. Free to download, no account required.

This file lists all pages on productifyapp.org with their markdown companion URLs, for use by AI agents and language models. Each HTML page has a corresponding `.md` file that returns the same content as `Content-Type: text/markdown`.

---

## How to access markdown versions

Replace the trailing `/` of any URL with `/index.md`, or append `index.md` to any page path:

- HTML: `https://productifyapp.org/blog/best-habit-tracker-apps-2026/`
- Markdown: `https://productifyapp.org/blog/best-habit-tracker-apps-2026/index.md`

All markdown files are signalled in each page's `<head>` via:
```html
<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown" href="index.md">
```

- **App:** [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/habit-tracker-productify/id1389900237)

- **Price:** Free to start · Pro subscription available
- **Account required:** No
- **App Store rating:** 4.9 stars
